#### What type of PR is this?

/kind feature

#### What this PR does / why we need it:

noderesourcefit: change PodUpdate QHint to take a new scenario into consideration

We have to change PodUpdate QHint in noderesourcefit to take into consideration that the pod might equal the unscheduled pod.
i.e.,
```go
func (f *Fit) isSchedulableAfterPodChange(logger klog.Logger, pod *v1.Pod, oldObj, newObj interface{}) (framework.QueueingHint, error) {
  // maybe pod == newObj (oldObj)
}
```

-->
Fixes #122354

#### Special notes for your reviewer:

It's for https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/122234. After https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/122234, the scheduler starts to use QueueingHint registered for Pod/Updated event to determine whether unschedulable Pods updates make them schedulable.

I'm not understanding the proposal.

If the modified pod is the scheduled pod, it would just enter the queue. The scheduling hint is irrelevant.

One important context is missed at PR description:
It's for #122234. After https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/122234, the scheduler starts to use QueueingHint registered for Pod/Updated event to determine whether unschedulable Pods updates make them schedulable.

> If the modified pod is the scheduled pod, it would just enter the queue. The scheduling hint is irrelevant.

This check is placed under the feature gate `InPlacePodVerticalScaling`. So it won't recreate the scheduled pod if it's a `isResourceScaleDown` event.

> If the modified pod is the scheduled pod

I guess you mean unscheduled pod? Then it's for https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/122234
It sounds like this change doesn't make sense on its own, and it should be part of https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/122234

> It sounds like this change doesn't make sense on its own, and it should be part of https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/122234


Hmmm, you're right. The ideal case should be #122234 got merged first before plugins implement their queueHint for pod event. However we implemented #122234 after the first version of noderesource's queueHint, which results in current scenario.😅

Whether we should include this to #122234 or not, I don't have any strong opinion. 
If both (@carlory @AxeZhan) agree, then @AxeZhan can just include this commit in #122234.
If @AxeZhan agree, feel free to close this pr.

> If @AxeZhan agree, feel free to close this pr.

👌 I'll bring this to https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/122234. Thanks @carlory !

review_comments:
Side question: What if the unscheduled Pod was assumed?

Doesn't that have the potential to free resources?
I missed this scenario. we should also check if the modified pod is assumed when its nodename is empty.
Add a new discussion here https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/122406, I think we can ignore the assumed pod for simple design.

If a pod is being assumed, the hintFn won't observe update event because the event is filtered by the [updatePodInSchedulingQueue](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/42ab3b7b40c34e91b63589ae905ed918752a4a36/pkg/scheduler/eventhandlers.go#L132). so we don't need consider this scenario
(I was commenting something, but deleted as it complicates the discussion here 😅 I'll create another issue for that.)
Let's continue this discussion in @kerthcet 's issue.
